rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.003, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.001, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-12 DECAY probe. Optimizer space is peaked at GD lr=0.01: iter-10 adam collapsed hr->0.0, iter-11 lr 0.01->0.02 hurt hr 0.3596->0.2396. Revert lr=0.01. Earlier GD logs show the TV term STILL descending at iter-1000, but with tv_decay=0.01 the GD step at iter1000 = 0.01/(1+0.01*1000) = ~0.0009 (11x shrunk) => late convergence is step-starved. ONE knob: tv_decay 0.01->0.001 (10x less decay; step at iter1000 = 0.01/2 = 0.005 vs 0.0009). HYPOTHESIS: larger late steps converge the TV term further within 1000 iters so hr rises past 0.3596; if too-large late steps oscillate (hr drops) decay=0.01 was protective and I revert + add iterations. Keep gd, lambda=3e-3, lr=0.01, 1000 iters, gamma=1.0. Budget: ~870s, <1200s wall.
